confidence_notes: Two web searches were run: one for the RBA rate and one for Marmaris prices. Food and drink anchors draw on aggregated figures from Numbeo-style and local price pages. Those figures are snippets that vary by source and date, so they are approximate. Beer, coffee and the inexpensive meal are reasonably supported. The mid-range meal for two is a bounded estimate between sources, which ranged from about $22 to about $45 or more. Cocktail and wine by the glass had no reliable direct Marmaris average. Cocktail is set from a bar-guide price of about EUR 7 and a roughly 2x ratio to beer. Wine is set from a mid-range bottle price of about $10 and a typical restaurant markup. The RBA figure was the published rate of 0.6720 for 2026-11-18 (the 4pm rate, quoted as USD per AUD), taken from a search summary, not from reading the RBA table directly. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for July peak season and were not searched. They are the least certain and vary widely by location and season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Compared with other Turkish Aegean and Mediterranean resort towns such as Bodrum, Fethiye and Kusadasi. Marmaris is a high-season, package-tourism resort, so prices in July sit above Turkish inland cities.
